integrity: The graph is the node–trope Levi incidence graph, not a surface Picard lattice. The construction and group are checked by exact algorithms; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The invariant is of the fixed abstract complex Kummer configuration, not a statement about a moduli-varying Jacobian or K3 discriminant. Historical priority may be limited by unindexed graph computations.
title: Integral critical group of the Kummer node–trope Levi graph
